summary: Read-only prompt review of Inspector 105 and Engineer 106, checked against ctg5-error-envelope-option-a.md, the review-4 technical PASS, transactional-command.ts/module.ts, the law error-envelope schema, the INV-ERROR-001 change_policy (human_approval_required) and the real faults/provenance/advanced specs. The prompts carry all four review-4 precisions, the role and path locks, the borrowed CTG6/CTG7 test locks, the legacy 504 STATEMENT_TIMEOUT / 503 SERIALIZATION_FAILURE / 500 wrong-role bodies, both 422s, the consumer-chosen 502, the RLS gates and the OD-S15-02 reservation of PR/RC/full CI. Four medium gaps block a PASS. (1) The Owner gate names no receipt artifact, and neither prompt makes the worker verify it and stop. (2) The Inspector prompt does not enumerate the 'Outros caminhos' reachability rows or setup/store faults, so those rows would have no red sensor. (3) The Engineer's phase model omits the pre-tx scope/tenancyPort callbacks and would misclassify selector/redaction failures inside writeAudit as 503 instead of 500 audit-metadata-failed. (4) The Inspector is not pointed at the Architect-amended errors.json as the oracle for the exact messages its toEqual assertions need. There are also low items: the regex-sensor symbol, the defensive checks and reference-gap path, the requestId scope, the lockfile, the named-spec log, DEVAI strict/check:trace, and the delivery-review handoff. Verdict REVIEW. This technical prompt review does not replace the Owner's human approval of option A under INV-ERROR-001, and no worker may be dispatched without it.
